'IME: -D OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG Legal Opinion No. 41 s. 2012 OUL 03 2012 MAYOR NANCY B. GREY San Jorge Samar Dear Mayor Grey: This pertains to your letter requesting clearance from this Department authorizing you to issue a memorandum for the purpose of reassigning personnel in your Municipality. At the outset, we note what you claimed as your Municipal Planning and Development Coordinator's refusal to receive official communication from your Office with respect to the Municipality's purchase of heavy equipment, which purchase has already been approved by this Department. Also, we note what you likewise claimed as your Municipal Treasurer's lack of support to your administration. With these, we are of the understanding that your intention in issuing the memorandum was prompted by the foregoing circumstances. Thus, you requested clearance from this Department for the issuance of said memorandum. By way of reply, please be reminded that basic is the rule that the power to appoint a public official includes the power to reassign, transfer or remove from office said official subject to the civil service laws, rules and regulations. Pertinently, as Municipal Mayor, you are specifically conferred by the Local Government Code of 1991 with the power to appoint your municipality's Treasurer, Planning and Development Coordinator and other appointive officials. As such, it is within your power to reassign, transfer or remove such officials provided only that said power is exercised in accordance with the civil service laws, rules and regulations. Accordingly, further clearance from this Department is no longer necessary. Please be guided accordingly.
